name: Navidrome
description: Lightweight music streaming server — browse albums, artists, playlists, and stream music
author: Crow

env_vars.name: NAVIDROME_USERNAME
env_vars.description: Navidrome username (Crow creates `admin` at install and writes it here)

env_vars.name: NAVIDROME_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Navidrome password. Crow generates it at install and keeps it in Settings → Passwords.

env_vars.name: NAVIDROME_MUSIC_PATH
env_vars.description: Host path for music files (Docker mode). Leave it empty to start with an empty library in Crow's folder (media/music); point it at your music later in Configure.
